'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Islamic terrorism in Europe]], [[Terrorism in Belgium]]
**[[2022 Brussels stabbing]]
***A [[Law enforcement in Belgium|police officer]] is killed and another is injured in a [[stabbing as a terrorist tactic|stabbing attack]] in [[Brussels]], [[Belgium]]. The perpetrator is shot and injured. The incident is being investigated as a [[terrorist]] attack. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-63586255 (BBC News)]

*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 Ukrainian southern counteroffensive]]
****The [[Ukrainian Armed Forces|Ukrainian military]] says that it recaptured the city of [[Snihurivka]] in [[Mykolaiv Oblast]], the last remaining city controlled by [[Russia]] in the oblast. [https://www.voanews.com/a/ukraine-says-it-recaptured-key-town-in-strategic-mykolaiv-region/6828366.html (Voice of America)]
****[[Ukrainian Ground Forces|Ukrainian troops]] recapture the village of [[Kyselivka, Kherson Raion|Kyselivka]], advancing within nine miles of the city centre of [[Kherson]]. Explosions are reported near the [[Kakhovka Hydroelectric Power Plant]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/nov/10/ukraine-capture-snihurivka-kherson-russia-war (''The Guardian'')]
***[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Foreign aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
****[[The Pentagon]] announces that it will send four [[AN/TWQ-1 Avenger]] [[surface-to-air missile]] systems, [[FIM-92 Stinger|Stinger missiles]], 400 [[grenade launcher]]s, 100 [[humvee]]s, and other artillery rounds and small arms ammunition to Ukraine as part of its latest [[US Dollar|$]]400 million weapons package to support the Ukrainian military. [https://thehill.com/policy/defense/3729848-us-to-send-ukraine-new-air-defense-system-as-part-of-new-400m-package/ (''The Hill'')]
*[[Moro conflict]]
**Three [[Armed Forces of the Philippines|soldiers]] and four [[Moro Islamic Liberation Front]] militants are killed in a gunbattle in [[Basilan]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/10/seven-killed-as-philippine-troops-clash-with-moro-islamic-rebels (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**Two people are killed after [[Hurricane Nicole (2022)|Hurricane Nicole]] makes landfall in [[Florida]], [[United States]], thereby bringing the death toll from the hurricane to eight. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/hurricane-nicole-makes-landfall-in-florida-11668069505 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
*Ten people are killed, nine of them [[Indians in the Maldives|Indians]], and many others are injured after a fire occurs at a building housing [[migrant worker]]s in [[Malé]], [[Maldives]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/10/nine-indians-among-10-workers-killed-in-maldives-fire-report (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2022 G20 Bali summit]]
**The [[List of diplomatic missions of Russia|Russian embassy]] in [[Jakarta]] confirms that [[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] will not attend the [[G20]] summit in [[Bali]] on November 15–16. However, the embassy intends to have Putin attend the summit virtually. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2022/11/10/latest-stories/putin-will-not-go-to-g20-summit-in-bali/1865800 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Treatment of women by the Taliban]]
**A [[Taliban]] spokesman for the [[Ministry for the Propagation of Virtue and the Prevention of Vice (Afghanistan)|Ministry for the Propagation of Virtue and the Prevention of Vice]] says that the group has issued an edict banning women from gyms, public parks and fun fairs because people were ignoring [[gender segregation|segregation]] orders and women were not wearing [[hijab]]s appropriately. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/taliban-official-women-banned-afghanistans-gyms-93039490 (ABC News)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/nov/10/taliban-ban-women-from-parks-and-funfairs-in-afghanistan-capital (AFP via ''The Guardian'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[NASA]] announces that an approximately {{conv|15|x|15|ft|m}} section of the [[Space Shuttle Challenger|Space Shuttle ''Challenger'']] has been found by divers in the [[Atlantic Ocean]]. It is the first debris from the shuttle to be found since 1996. [https://apnews.com/article/challenger-space-shuttle-found-in-ocean-064e47171452894d6494f142fea26126 (AP)]
